title: A Nearly Quartic Separation Between Randomized and Quantum Query Complexity

nodes.label: def-log-convention
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: log means log_2, except where changing the base only changes an absolute constant. Ledger pinning: log in T (prop-3.2), r and l (eq-6) and L (eq-5) is exactly log_2.

nodes.label: def-partial-query
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: A partial Boolean function is a pair (D,P) with D a subset of {0,1}^N and P:D->{0,1}. An algorithm computes it if it is correct, with the stated error, on every x in D; behaviour off D is unconstrained.

nodes.label: def-R
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For a (partial) Boolean function f, R(f) is the least q such that some probability distribution on deterministic decision trees of depth at most q satisfies Pr[T(x)=f(x)] >= 2/3 for every x in dom f. The query cap holds on every branch and every coin outcome.

nodes.label: def-query-oracle
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Finite query-coordinate type; a natural workspace parameter.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For x in {0,1}^n the bit oracle is the unitary O_x|i,b,z> = |i, b xor x_i, z>, with i in [n], b a bit, z a workspace label. It is self-inverse.

nodes.label: def-Q
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Q(f) is the least q such that some quantum algorithm, with unrestricted query-free computation between uses of O_x and with at most q queries on every branch including all measurement outcomes, outputs f(x) with probability >= 2/3 for every x in dom f.

nodes.label: eq-1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: alpha_tot = inf{alpha >= 0 : exists C_alpha < infinity such that for every n >= 1 and every total f:{0,1}^n->{0,1}, R(f) <= C_alpha (1+Q(f))^alpha}.

nodes.label: eq-2
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: l+1>=2; sufficiently large t; m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For fixed integer k>=2 and all sufficiently large powers of four m: Q(F_{k,m}) <= C_k sqrt(m) (log m)^{b_k} and R(F_{k,m}) >= c_k m^{2-1/k}/(log m)^2, with c_k,C_k,b_k>0 depending only on k.

nodes.label: thm-1.1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: alpha_tot = 4. More precisely, R(f) = O((1+Q(f))^4) for every total Boolean f, and eq-2 holds for each fixed integer k>=2.

nodes.label: cor-cubic-refuted
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: It is false that R(f) = O(Q(f)^3) for all total Boolean f ([3, Conjecture 2]): no C satisfies R(f) <= C Q(f)^3 for all total f.

nodes.label: def-walsh-sign
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: m=4^t and k bit-sign strings.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: m=4^t. H is the m x m normalized Walsh-Hadamard matrix, H_{a,b}=m^{-1/2}(-1)^{<a,b>} for a,b in {0,1}^{log_2 m}. u=m^{-1/2}(1,...,1)^T. A bit a is identified with the sign (-1)^a. For z in {+-1}^m, D_z=diag(z).

nodes.label: eq-3
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: k>=1 (the paper uses k>=2); m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For z_1,...,z_k in {+-1}^m: Phi(z_1,...,z_k) = u^T D_{z_1} H D_{z_2} H ... H D_{z_k} u (k diagonals, k-1 copies of H), and delta = 2^{-5k}.

nodes.label: eq-4
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: P=P_{k,m} is the partial function on km bits with P=1 if Phi>=delta, P=0 if |Phi|<=delta/2, undefined otherwise. The two cases are disjoint.

nodes.label: eq-5
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.

nodes.label: claim-bs-to-L
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Fixed k>=2; c>0; sufficiently large powers m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For fixed k>=2 and the positive constant c of the Bansal-Sinha bound: for all sufficiently large powers of four m, c k^{-29} (m/log(km))^{1-1/k} > floor(m^{1-1/k}/(log_2 m)^2).

nodes.label: lem-2.1.i
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For fixed k>=2 and all sufficiently large powers of four m, R(P_{k,m})>L with L as in eq-5.

nodes.label: claim-proj-prob
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Prepare u, apply D_{z_1} H ... H D_{z_k} right to left, measure the projection onto u. Each D uses one bit query (phase kickback), H and the projection use none. Success probability is exactly Phi^2: >=delta^2 on 1-inputs, <=delta^2/4 on 0-inputs.

nodes.label: lem-2.1.ii
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Fixed k>=1; m=4^t; 0<eta<1/2.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For every 0<eta<1/2 there is a quantum algorithm using O_k(1+log(1/eta)) bit queries that outputs P_{k,m}(z) with error <=eta for every z in dom P. It has a coherent implementation retaining all workspace. On every input, promised or not, measuring its output register yields a bit.

nodes.label: claim-N-phi
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: k>=1; m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: With W=sqrt(m) H (entries +-1), N = z_1^T W D_{z_2} W ... W D_{z_k} (1,...,1)^T is an integer, Phi=N/M_{k,m}, and M_{k,m}=m (sqrt m)^{k-1} is a positive integer because m is a power of four.

nodes.label: claim-integer-tests
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Phi>=delta iff 2^{5k} N >= M_{k,m}; and |Phi|<=delta/2 iff 2^{5k+1}|N| <= M_{k,m}. d is the disjunction, b the first comparison.

nodes.label: claim-circuit-size
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: N is computed by k-1 unnormalized Walsh-Hadamard transforms, coordinate sign changes and a final signed sum. Each transform uses O(m log m) additions and subtractions; all intermediate integers have absolute value at most m^{O(k)}, so O_k(log m) bits suffice; hence Boolean size O_k(m (log m)^2).

nodes.label: lem-2.1.iii
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: There is a Boolean circuit C=C_{k,m} of fan-in at most two and size S=S_{k,m}=O_k(m (log m)^2), counting non-input gates, with output bits d,b such that for every input z: d=1 iff P_{k,m} is defined at z, and d=1 implies b=P_{k,m}(z). The circuit computes these outputs exactly on every input.

nodes.label: lem-2.1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Fixed k>=2; m=4^t, with t sufficiently large for the randomized part and t>=1 for the circuit part.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Conjunction of lem-2.1.i, lem-2.1.ii and lem-2.1.iii for each fixed k>=2.

nodes.label: def-transcript
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For a fixed circuit, a transcript assigns a proposed bit to each non-input gate, including output gates. Input-wire values are not copied; they are read from the actual input.

nodes.label: eq-6
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: m=4^t.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: r = ceil(20 log_2 m), l = log_2 m.

nodes.label: def-column-layout
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: The input has m columns. Column i contains: X_i in {0,1}^m; strings A_{i,1},...,A_{i,r} in {0,1}^{km} with no promise; and for each s in {0,1}^r a cell B_{i,s} holding, for each j != i, a pointer p_{i,s,j} in [m] encoded in l bits by a fixed bijection, and for each h in [r] an alleged evaluation transcript of C_{k,m} on A_{i,h}.

nodes.label: def-eval-transcript
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: An evaluation transcript of C_{k,m} on A_{i,h} has one bit per non-input gate including output gates, and these gates are the count S. It is correct iff every bit equals the true value of that gate on input A_{i,h}.

nodes.label: eq-7
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Every instance of the selected column is promised; arbitrary finite address length.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If every P(A_{i,h}) is defined, the true address of column i is s_i=(P(A_{i,1}),...,P(A_{i,r})) in {0,1}^r.

nodes.label: eq-8
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Outward pointer condition at address s: X_j[p_{i,s,j}] = 0 for every j != i. Eq. 8 of the paper is the case s=s_i.

nodes.label: def-winner
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Column i is a winner iff X_i=1^m, every P(A_{i,h}) is defined, and the cell B_{i,s_i} contains correct evaluation transcripts on all A_{i,h} and pointers satisfying eq-8.

nodes.label: def-F
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: F_{k,m}(y)=1 if some column of y is a winner, else 0. It is a total Boolean function on all input bit strings.

nodes.label: cor-unique-winner
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Two columns satisfy the winner predicate on the same input.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For every input, at most one column is a winner.

nodes.label: def-win-at-address
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: WinsAt(y,i,s) holds iff X_i=1^m, for every h the transcript in B_{i,s} on A_{i,h} is correct with outputs d=1 and b=s_h, and eq-8 holds at s. The paper's wording, i is a winner and s=s_i, is equivalent by claim-winner-fidelity.

nodes.label: def-K
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.

nodes.label: lem-2.2.i
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: For every input y and (i,s) in [m] x {0,1}^r: i wins at s iff all K_{k,m} tests pass, namely (a) X_i[b]=1 for each b; (b) for each j != i, X_j[p_{i,s,j}]=0; (c) for each h and each non-input gate, the claimed value equals the gate function of its predecessors, read from the transcript or from A_{i,h}; (d) for each h, claimed d=1 and claimed b=s_h. Each test is computed by a deterministic adaptive bit-query decision tree of depth at most max(3,l+1), which is l+1 for m>=4: a pointer test reads l pointer bits, then the one target bit they select, while gate tests read at most three fixed bits. A pointer test is not a function of a small fixed set of bits: it can depend on all l+m pointer and target coordinates.

nodes.label: lem-2.2.ii
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: t>=1; C realizes P; C.size<=A*mValue(t)*(2t)^2; these properties are supplied for the specified circuit.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Each test is evaluated exactly with O(log m) bit queries, also coherently with the same bound with test indices in superposition. The number of tests and the indexing convention are the same for every (i,s).

nodes.label: lem-2.2
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: t>=1; C realizes P; C.size<=A m (2t)^2 with fixed A supplied by Lemma 2.1(iii).. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Conjunction of lem-2.2.i and lem-2.2.ii.

nodes.label: cor-local-dichotomy
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Circuit realization, discharged for the actual circuit.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: A winner has an address at which every test passes; a nonwinner has a failing test at every address.

nodes.label: def-grover-trial
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: M = ceil(10/sqrt(gamma)). A trial picks with probability 1/2 l=0, and with probability 1/2 a uniform l in {0,...,M-1}, applies l Grover iterations to A|0>, and measures the success bit. The procedure runs ceil(log(1/eta)/log(40/31)) trials with fresh registers, stopping at the first success.

nodes.label: claim-grover-state
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: A Preparation in a complex inner-product space; 0<A.prob<1.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For 0<p<1 write A|0>=sin(theta)|g>+cos(theta)|b>, 0<theta<pi/2, with g,b normalized in the successful and unsuccessful subspaces. After l Grover iterations the state is sin((2l+1)theta)|g>+cos((2l+1)theta)|b>. Hence measuring success yields |g> up to global phase, independently of l.

nodes.label: claim-sin2theta
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: gamma<=A.prob<=1/2.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If gamma<=p<=1/2 then sin(2theta)=2 sqrt(p(1-p)) >= sqrt(gamma).

nodes.label: eq-9
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: gamma>0 and gamma<=A.prob<=1/2.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If gamma<=p<=1/2 and M=ceil(10/sqrt(gamma)), then (1/M) sum_{l=0}^{M-1} sin^2((2l+1)theta) >= 1/2 - 1/(2M|sin 2theta|) >= 9/20.

nodes.label: lem-3.1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For 0<gamma<=1/2 and 0<eta<1/2 there is a single procedure, black-box in A and A^{-1} and with call counts depending only on gamma and eta, using O(gamma^{-1/2} log(1/eta)) calls for every p and on every branch, such that for every state preparation A with a success bit, success probability p and, if p>0, normalized successful state |g>: it reports failure or produces a successful outcome; conditional on success the output is |g> up to global phase; if p>=gamma, failure probability <=eta; if p=0 it always reports failure.

nodes.label: def-aij
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: For a fixed oracle input and a coherent comparison circuit, a_{ij} is the probability that i is reported as defeating j when the result is measured, using one circuit per unordered pair; a_{ii}=0.

nodes.label: eq-10
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: a_{ij}+a_{ji}=1 for i != j, and a_{ii}=0.

nodes.label: def-T-eps
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For m>=2: T=ceil(log_2(1000m)), epsilon=1/(1000T).

nodes.label: eq-11
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: i_* is dominant if a_{i_* j} >= 1-epsilon for every j != i_*.

nodes.label: def-ideal-process
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Ideal process: w_i=1 for all i, W=sum_i w_i. While W>0 sample p with probability w_p/W, append p to the list, update by eq-12. If W=0, leave list and weights unchanged. Run T steps.

nodes.label: eq-12
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Update w_i <- w_i a_{ip} for all i in [m].

nodes.label: eq-13
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Finite candidates; IsComparison a; W=sum w>0.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For W>0: E[W_new | w] = (1/W) sum_{p,i} w_p w_i a_{ip} = (W^2 - sum_i w_i^2)/(2W) <= W/2.

nodes.label: claim-expected-WT
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: The bound of eq-13 also holds when W=0, hence E[W_T] <= m/2^T.

nodes.label: claim-weight-lb
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Unit-valued comparisons; 0<=epsilon<=1; dominant s; length L<=T; s not in L; T epsilon<1/2.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If i_* satisfies eq-11 and has not been selected in t<=T steps, then w_{i_*} >= (1-epsilon)^t >= 1-T epsilon > 1/2. Hence W>0 until it is selected.

nodes.label: eq-14
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Pr[i_* absent from the ideal list] <= Pr[W_T >= 1/2] <= 2m/2^T.

nodes.label: construct-sampler
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Given pivots p_1,...,p_t with t<T: prepare uniform |i> over [m], compare i with each pivot in a fresh workspace, set the success bit iff every comparison says i defeats its pivot, keeping all garbage. Apply lem-3.1 with gamma=1/(2m), eta=epsilon. On failure stop and return the accumulated list; otherwise measure the index, append, and continue for at most T stages.

nodes.label: eq-15
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Finite nonempty candidate set; common finite workspace/origin; comparison isometries IsCirc c; fixed pivot sequence.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Pre-success state: m^{-1/2} sum_{i=1}^m |i> tensor_{b=1}^t |phi(i,p_b)>.

nodes.label: claim-success-prob
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Finite nonempty candidate set; comparisons in [0,1]; W=total(weight)>0 so conditioning is meaningful.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Conditional on index i the success probability is prod_{b=1}^t a_{i p_b} = w_i (empty product 1). Total success probability is W/m, and conditional on success the index has law w_i/W exactly.

nodes.label: claim-coupling
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Until i_* is first selected, W/m >= 1/(2m), so at each such history the sampler fails with probability <=epsilon and otherwise follows the exact ideal pivot law. The real list contains i_* except with probability <= 2m/2^T + T epsilon.

nodes.label: claim-tournament-cost
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: m>=2; any natural common logical-read count cc.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Stage t uses O(c(t+1)) queries per call; lem-3.1 uses O(sqrt(m) log(1/epsilon)) calls; the sum over t<T is O(c sqrt(m) T^2 log T), a fixed cap on every branch.

nodes.label: prop-3.2
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: At least two finite candidates; comparison probabilities satisfy IsComparison pointwise; coherent comparison Samples at a common cc-read cap.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Let m>=2, T=ceil(log_2(1000m)), epsilon=1/(1000T). For a coherent comparison circuit controlled by two candidate indices, reversible with all workspace retained, using at most c>=1 bit queries, with probabilities a_{ij} satisfying eq-10, there is a quantum algorithm making O(c sqrt(m) T^2 log T) queries on every branch and returning a list of at most T candidates such that, for every fixed oracle input and every i_* satisfying eq-11, the list contains i_* with probability >= 1-2m/2^T-T epsilon.

nodes.label: def-decode
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: decode(i): run the algorithm of lem-2.1.ii on each A_{i,h}, h in [r], with error <= epsilon/r, retaining workspace. Output a string in {0,1}^r on every input.

nodes.label: claim-decode-cost
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: decode uses O_k(r log(r/epsilon)) = (log m)^{O_k(1)} queries. If all r instances are defined, the address is correct with probability >=1-epsilon. Otherwise it still returns some address.

nodes.label: def-comparison
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Comparison of distinct columns, in sorted order: decode each in separate workspaces; read each column's pointer towards the other at its decoded address and inspect the pointed bit of the other's X string. A column disqualifies its opponent if that bit is 0. If exactly one disqualifies the other it is victorious, otherwise the smaller index. A self-comparison returns false without reading a pointer.

nodes.label: claim-comparison-state
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: The comparison uses c=(log m)^{O_k(1)} queries; its reversal costs the same. Measurement probabilities agree with the classical description, since later operations are controlled on the decoded registers in the computational basis. The resulting a_{ij} satisfy eq-10.

nodes.label: claim-winner-dominates
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: k>=1; t>=1; 0<epsilon<=1; prescribed repetitions; a WinsAt witness for the winner; opponent is distinct.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If i_* is a winner then for every j != i_*, a_{i_* j} >= 1-epsilon, on every input, whether or not the opponent's instances are defined.

nodes.label: def-verify
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: verify(i): decode and measure an address s afresh. Let A prepare a uniform test index and an exact failing-test flag at (i,s), with K tests. Apply lem-3.1 with gamma=1/K and eta=epsilon. Reject if a failed test is found, otherwise accept. Output 1 iff some listed candidate is accepted.

nodes.label: claim-verify
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: A non-winner is accepted with probability <=epsilon, at every address. A true winner is rejected with probability <=epsilon, only by decoding error. Verification costs O(sqrt(K) log(1/epsilon) log m) = sqrt(m)(log m)^{O_k(1)} queries for the search, plus decoding.

nodes.label: claim-error
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: On a 0-input the error is at most T epsilon. On a 1-input it is at most 2m/2^T + T epsilon + epsilon < 1/3.

nodes.label: claim-coherent-access
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: All superposed array accesses are ordinary bit queries. The global bit index is computed reversibly; a pointer is read in O(log m) queries; a controlled query uses load, use, unload, two queries.

nodes.label: prop-3.3
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For every fixed k>=2, Q(F_{k,m}) <= sqrt(m) (log m)^{O_k(1)}.

nodes.label: claim-product-law
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Finite independent nonnegative prior weights for the probabilistic interpretation; the equality itself allows arbitrary real weights.; The conditioning transcript has strictly positive total mass.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For a deterministic algorithm, at every transcript tau of positive probability, the conditional law of (U_1,...,U_r) given tau is a product of separate conditional laws, because the event of obtaining tau is a Cartesian product of constraints on each input.

nodes.label: def-value-V
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: With q_h queries already made to U_h, V_h(tau) is the largest success probability for computing P(U_h) under its conditional law given tau using at most L-q_h further queries.

nodes.label: eq-16
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: If the next query at tau addresses U_h then E[V_h(tau') | tau] <= V_h(tau). The conditional laws and budgets of the other inputs do not change.

nodes.label: claim-supermartingale
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: E[prod_j V_j(tau') | tau] <= prod_j V_j(tau). The product is a supermartingale over at most rL queries.

nodes.label: claim-final-bound
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Nonnegative transcript-restricted weights.; The final transcript fixes the chosen output vector.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: At the final transcript tau, Pr[chosen vector correct | tau] <= prod_h max_b Pr(P(U_h)=b | tau) <= prod_h V_h(tau).

nodes.label: lem-4.1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Let P:D->{0,1}, D subset {0,1}^n, mu a distribution on D, L a nonnegative integer. Suppose every deterministic algorithm making at most L queries computes P under mu with success probability <=beta. If U_1,...,U_r are iid mu, every classical algorithm making at most L queries to each U_h, possibly randomized, adaptive among the r inputs, and given arbitrary additional information independent of (U_1,...,U_r), outputs (P(U_1),...,P(U_r)) with probability <=beta^r.

nodes.label: claim-minimax-mu
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: If L<R(P), there is a distribution mu on dom P, which is in particular nonempty, such that every deterministic tree of depth <=L has success probability <=2/3 under mu.

nodes.label: eq-17
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: G = floor(mL/100).

nodes.label: def-dummy
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: The address weight is nonnegative and sums to one when interpreted as a distribution.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Dummy input Y^(0): independently for each i, J_i uniform in [m], X_i has a single 0 at position J_i. All A_{i,h} are iid mu independent of the J_i. All cells B_{i,s} are one fixed blank pattern.

nodes.label: def-planted
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: The address weight is a probability law supported on the promise.; The transcript map is correct when the sampled input is intended to be a positive instance.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: I is uniform in [m] and independent of Y^(0). Y^(1) is Y^(0) with X_I:=1^m and B_{I,s_I} filled with the correct transcripts and pointers p_{I,s_I,j}=J_j for j != I.

nodes.label: claim-Y-values
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: F_{k,m}(Y^(0))=0 and F_{k,m}(Y^(1))=1 for all sample points.

nodes.label: eq-18
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Nonnegative address weights.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For a deterministic algorithm with at most G queries, |Pr[outputs 1 on Y^(1)]-Pr[outputs 1 on Y^(0)]| <= Pr(the dummy run queries X_I[J_I]) + Pr(the dummy run queries any bit of B_{I,s_I}).

nodes.label: def-Z
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Z is the number of columns whose zero is discovered in the dummy run.

nodes.label: claim-uniform-zero
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Nonnegative normalized address law.; No zero has been observed in the selected column.; The full adaptive transcript has positive dummy probability.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Before the zero in a column is found, its location is uniform among positions of that column not yet queried, conditional on the full adaptive transcript.

nodes.label: claim-EZ
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: E Z <= 4G/m: an early discovery (fewer than m/2 distinct positions queried in that column before it) has probability <=2/m per query, giving <=2G/m in expectation; any other discovery lies in one of at most 2G/m columns receiving >=m/2 queries.

nodes.label: eq-19
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Pr(the dummy run queries X_I[J_I]) = E Z/m <= 4G/m^2.

nodes.label: def-heavy
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Column i is heavy if, over the entire dummy run, the algorithm makes more than L queries in total to A_{i,1},...,A_{i,r}. Repeats count.

nodes.label: eq-20
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: 1<=L; l.length <= G. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Pr(I is heavy) <= G/(mL).

nodes.label: def-simulator
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Lean time t is the paper proposed query number t+1.; The selected column is fixed before the target strings are resampled.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Fix i and t in {1,...,G}. A simulator receives all of the dummy input outside A_{i,1},...,A_{i,r}, runs the deterministic algorithm up to its proposed t-th query, and aborts before an (L+1)st query to those r strings in total. If it reaches time t and the proposed query is to a cell B_{i,s}, it outputs s; otherwise it outputs a fixed vector.

nodes.label: eq-21
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Normalized nonnegative prior supported on the promise.; Every one-instance L-query tree has success at most 2/3.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For each i and t: Pr(i is nonheavy and the t-th query is in B_{i,s_i}) <= (2/3)^r.

nodes.label: eq-22
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: 1 <= L; normalized nonnegative promise-supported prior.; One-instance hardness at cap L.; Worst-case depth at most G.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Pr(the dummy run queries B_{I,s_I}) <= G/(mL) + G(2/3)^r.

nodes.label: eq-23
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: 1 <= L; normalized nonnegative promise-supported prior.; One-instance hardness at cap L.; Worst-case depth at most G.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: The output-probability difference is at most 4G/m^2 + G/(mL) + G(2/3)^r.

nodes.label: claim-tail
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.

nodes.label: claim-numeric
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: m=4^t, r=40*t, 1 <= L <= m and G <= mL/100.. Additional open assumptions: none.

nodes.label: prop-4.2
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Fixed integer k >= 2.; CircuitRealises C (P k t).. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For each fixed integer k>=2 and every sufficiently large power of four m, R(F_{k,m}) > G=floor(mL/100), with L=floor(m^{1-1/k}/(log_2 m)^2).

nodes.label: cor-R-omega
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Fixed integer k >= 2.; The circuit realizes the designated promise problem.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For fixed k, R(F_{k,m}) = Omega_k(m^{2-1/k}/(log m)^2).

nodes.label: claim-floor
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For sufficiently large m, floor((m/100) floor(m^{1-1/k}/(log m)^2)) >= c_k m^{2-1/k}/(log m)^2 after decreasing c_k>0.

nodes.label: claim-exponent-ratio
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: l and alpha are fixed before t tends to infinity.; 0 <= alpha and alpha/2 < 2 - 1/(l+1); these imply alpha < 4.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For fixed 0<=alpha<4 and integer k>=2 with 2-1/k>alpha/2: R(F_{k,m})/(1+Q(F_{k,m}))^alpha >= c_{k,alpha} m^{2-1/k-alpha/2}/(log m)^{2+alpha b_k}, which tends to infinity.

nodes.label: claim-no-smaller-exponent
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: alpha < 4. Additional open assumptions: FamilyBounds; hRreindex (proved as R_reindex); hQreindex (proved as Q_reindex).
nodes.statement: For every 0<=alpha<4, alpha does not belong to the set in eq-1, because a suitable k exists with k > 1/(2-alpha/2).

nodes.label: def-D
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: D(f) is the least depth of a deterministic decision tree computing f exactly on every input.

nodes.label: def-deg
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: deg(f) is the degree of the unique real multilinear polynomial agreeing with f on the cube, with degree 0 for every constant function, including the zero function. With this convention it is unchanged by replacing input or output bits by signs.

nodes.label: def-bs
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: A nonempty B subset [n] is a sensitive block at x if flipping all bits of B changes f(x). bs(f) is the maximum over x of the number of pairwise disjoint sensitive blocks at x.

nodes.label: def-Gamma-i
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: For an input-indexed matrix Gamma, (Gamma_i)_{xy}=Gamma_{xy} 1{x_i != y_i}. Matrix norms are operator norms for the Euclidean norm.

nodes.label: claim-perron
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Symmetry and entrywise nonnegativity of Gamma.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: A nonzero real symmetric entrywise nonnegative Gamma has a nonnegative unit eigenvector v of eigenvalue ||Gamma||.

nodes.label: def-adv-progress
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: For the algorithm interpretation substitute the purified fixed-sequence states.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: W_t = sum_{x,y} v_x v_y Gamma_{xy} <psi_x^t | psi_y^t>, where psi_x^t is the purified state after t queries on input x.

nodes.label: claim-per-query
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: Each query changes W by at most: |W_{t+1}-W_t| <= 2 sum_i u_i^T Gamma_i u_i <= 2 max_i ||Gamma_i||, where u_i(x)=v_x ||phi_{x,i}||.

nodes.label: claim-final-overlap
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: If Pr[output 1] is <=1/3 on one state and >=2/3 on another, their overlap has absolute value <=2 sqrt(2)/3. Hence |W_final| <= (2 sqrt(2)/3)||Gamma||.

nodes.label: lem-A.2
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Gamma is symmetric, nonnegative, nonzero and zero on same-output pairs.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Let f be a nonconstant total Boolean function, Gamma a nonzero real symmetric entrywise nonnegative input-indexed matrix with Gamma_{xy}=0 whenever f(x)=f(y). Then Q(f) >= c ||Gamma|| / max_i ||Gamma_i|| for an absolute constant c>0.

nodes.label: def-Sf
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: S_f is the adjacency matrix on {0,1}^n of the graph joining inputs that differ in exactly one bit and have different f-values. lambda(f)=||S_f||.

nodes.label: lem-A.3.bs
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For nonconstant total f, bs(f)=O(Q(f)^2).

nodes.label: lem-A.3.lambda
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: For nonconstant total f, lambda(f)=O(Q(f)).

nodes.label: lem-A.3
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Conjunction of lem-A.3.bs and lem-A.3.lambda.

nodes.label: claim-restrict-parity
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: The function has nonzero degree.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: With f in sign form and d=deg f>=1, restricting variables outside a degree-d monomial's support gives g on the d-cube with nonzero parity correlation. So for some sigma in {-1,1}, U={x:g(x)=sigma x_1...x_d} has |U|>2^{d-1}, and every cube edge inside U changes g.

nodes.label: def-huang
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: H'_1=[[0,1],[1,0]], H'_{j+1}=[[H'_j,I],[I,-H'_j]]. Its entrywise absolute value is the cube adjacency matrix.

nodes.label: claim-huang-spectrum
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: (H'_j)^2=jI, trace H'_j=0, so H'_d has eigenvalues +-sqrt(d), each of multiplicity 2^{d-1}.

nodes.label: claim-interlace
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: Positive dimension and a vertex set of cardinality greater than half the cube.. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: There is a nonzero v in the sqrt(d)-eigenspace supported on U; with u=|v|, u^T A_U u >= v^T H'_d v = sqrt(d)||u||^2.

nodes.label: lem-A.4
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Every nonconstant total Boolean f satisfies deg(f) <= lambda(f)^2.

nodes.label: claim-round-block
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification.
nodes.statement: In each round of the algorithm on input x, with S the selected maximum-degree monomial's support in the current restriction, the restriction to S with all other unqueried variables set as in x is nonconstant. So some nonempty subset of S is a sensitive block at x. Blocks of different rounds are disjoint.

nodes.label: lem-A.5
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Every total Boolean f satisfies D(f) <= bs(f) deg(f).

nodes.label: thm-A.1
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Every total Boolean function satisfies R(f) <= D(f) = O((1+Q(f))^4), with an absolute constant.

nodes.label: claim-address-guess
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Under mu from claim-minimax-mu, for U_1,...,U_r iid mu, every classical algorithm making at most L queries to each U_h, given information independent of (U_1,...,U_r), outputs (P(U_1),...,P(U_r)) with probability <=(2/3)^r.

nodes.label: prop-4.2-generic
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: C realises f; 1<=L; L<=m; L < R f. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Let m=4^t with t>=1 and r=40t. Let P be a partial function on km bits with an exact circuit C (d=1 iff defined, and d=1 implies b=P), and F the total function built from (P,C). If 1<=L<=m and L<R(P), then R(F)>floor(mL/100).

nodes.label: claim-winner-fidelity
nodes.boundary: Informal statement projection; no native formal declaration export or independent semantic verification. Selected tied theorem metadata. Ordinary premises: none. Additional open assumptions: none.
nodes.statement: Given the correctness half of lem-2.1.iii: WinsAt(y,i,s) iff X_i=1^m, every P(A_{i,h}) is defined, s=s_i, the transcripts in B_{i,s} are correct, and eq-8 holds. Hence exists s, WinsAt(y,i,s) is the paper's winner condition.
